fields.name: site
fields.label: Site

options.notes: Fetched by useEnvData as ?location_type=Site&location_type=Module (ui/src/hooks/useEnvData.ts:37). The submitted form value is not the raw id: mapLocationOptions encodes 'dcim-location:["<location_type>","<id>"]' when location_type is set and falls back to the bare id otherwise (ui/src/lib/location-options.ts:25-36). Static param is repeated (array).

fields.query_param_normalization: single value (searchParams.get('site')); resolved against loaded location options by encoded value, provider id, or display name (resolveLocationFormValue, ui/src/lib/location-options.ts:62-77); unresolvable -> site and device cleared; ignored after a manual site change (ui/src/components/forms/workflow.tsx:228-246)
fields.submit_transform: UI-only filter; not sent. Changing it clears device (ui/src/components/forms/workflow.tsx:264-268,302-312)

fields.name: tenant
fields.label: Tenant (optional)

options.notes: Fetched by useEnvData (ui/src/hooks/useEnvData.ts:71, mapped at :96-99). Selection change clears device (ui/src/components/forms/workflow.tsx:90-99).

fields.query_param_normalization: multi-value (searchParams.getAll('tenant')), empty strings dropped, filtered to values present in loaded tenant options; re-applied whenever the query changes (manual flag reset) (ui/src/components/forms/workflow.tsx:167-170,270-288)

fields.label: Status (optional)

options.notes: Fetched by useEnvData (ui/src/hooks/useEnvData.ts:60, mapped at :92-95). Selection change clears device (ui/src/components/forms/workflow.tsx:130-139).

fields.query_param_normalization: multi-value (searchParams.getAll('status')), empty strings dropped, filtered to values present in loaded status options; re-applied whenever the query changes (manual flag reset) (ui/src/components/forms/workflow.tsx:171-174,273-300)

fields.name: device_id
fields.label: Device
fields.schema_description: Identifier of the UFM device to inspect.

options.notes: Request suppressed until site is non-empty; the encoded site value is decoded into site=<id> plus site_type=<location_type> query params (ui/src/hooks/useDevices.ts:43-56). Rows map name -> label, id -> value (useDevices.ts:59-61). tenant/status are optional and sent as one repeated param per selected value (ui/src/components/forms/workflow.tsx:205-224). managed_only omitted because the page passes managedOnly={false} (ui/src/app/workflows/infinibandgetunhealthyportsworkflow/form/page.tsx:49-50).

fields.query_param_normalization: single value (searchParams.get('device-id')); kept only if present in the loaded device options for the current site/tenant/status/platform filter, otherwise cleared; ignored after a manual device change (ui/src/components/forms/workflow.tsx:248-262)
client_only_validation: non-empty after trim ('Device is required'); schema has no minLength

payload_transform: {device_id: values.device} (ui/src/app/workflows/infinibandgetunhealthyportsworkflow/form/page.tsx:32-34); site, tenant, status and the unrendered commit_confirm (showCommitConfirm=false) are dropped. startWorkflow POSTs to /v1/workflow/ngc/infiniband_get_unhealthy_ports; 2xx redirects to /workflows/{id}; on error the page toasts 'Failed to create workflow: <error>' and rethrows so DeviceWorkflowForm re-enables submit (ui/src/app/workflows/infinibandgetunhealthyportsworkflow/form/page.tsx:35-42, ui/src/components/forms/workflow.tsx:191-199). Submit is disabled while any option list is loading (ui/src/components/forms/workflow.tsx:417-425).
discrepancies: site, tenant and status are UI-only filters; InfinibandGetUnhealthyPortsInput has only device_id.
device_id non-empty is client-only (schema string with no minLength).
Label 'Device' vs schema title 'Device Id'; schema description ('Identifier of the UFM device to inspect.') is not shown.
managedOnly=false: the device list includes unmanaged UFM devices (platform=UFM only).

e2e coverage (ui/tests/e2e/ibGetUnhealthyPortsForm.spec.ts, ui/tests/e2e/shared/workflowFormTests.ts) exercises site and device-id prefill only; tenant/status prefill and filtering are untested for this form.
Docs screenshot uses PDX_MLNX_QUERY (an MLNX-OS device-id) for this platform=UFM form (ui/tests/docs-screenshots/workflowForms.spec.ts:352-355,462-466), so the device prefill is dropped as invalid.
contract_gaps: BLOCKING for generic: site, tenant and status are UI-only filters, not input-model fields, so they cannot carry UiHints and field dependencies cannot reference them. Needs a device_reference widget with built-in site/tenant/status scope or a UI-only field concept.
Site option values are encoded 'dcim-location:[type,id]' and must expand into site + site_type device query params (ui/src/hooks/useDevices.ts:43-50); depends_on sends one raw value per param.
Location options need a repeated static param (location_type=Site&location_type=Module); OptionSource.params values are scalar-only.
Multi-valued dependencies (tenant/status arrays -> repeated query params) have no defined serialization in depends_on.
Optional vs required dependencies: the device list must load with only site set, so the option source must distinguish optional from required dependencies.
Clearing device when site, tenant or status changes has no v1 key.
Prefill normalization is not expressible: site resolved by id/name/encoded value; device-id, tenant and status dropped unless present in loaded options; prefill stops after manual edits.
